page.layout: One printed page, single column of text; a marginal note at the left margin ("ubi supra."), with a running head at the top and a decorated initial. Blocks in reading order: running head; main column from top to bottom including a rule and an italic heading; the left-margin note beside the paragraph with the initial; a digitiser's watermark at the bottom right is ignored.

main_text.p: ta, sanè, Christus duodecim fundamentorum numero, ut decimum tertium, non potest adjici, nec etiam ut primum; quia cum illa non sint sui ordinis, nec etiam una numerantur. Itaque ad quaestionem nostram tractandam, hujus generis secundi fundamentorum, vel eorumdem alicujus, investigatio plane fuerit inutilis. Hæc de argumento in genere.

Ad locum Matthaei quod attinet, an Christus se Ecclesiam super Petrum ædificaturum, ipsúmque quoquomodo fundamentum facturum spondeat, variant veterum & recentium tractatorum sententiæ, non diversâ fide: Sive varii apparent in scriptis eorum circa hujus scripturæ explicationem & applicationem, conceptus. Quapropter, in gratiam studiosi lectoris, principes eorundem, in hoc argumento, observationes & sententias referre est animus, ut ex earum comparatione, expositionis argumentis sacræ Scripturæ magis firmatæ veritas elucescat,
main_text.head: Declaratio expositionis primæ, quâ, ex fundamentis in plurali expressis, Petrus unum designatum à Domino statuitur.
main_text.p: NON satis habet Gregorius fundamenti absolutè, & singulari significatione, sumpti applicationem uni Christo vendicare: Regulam insuper de fundamentis plurali numero enuntiatis adjicit, in scriptura sacra non esse aliud quàm prædicatores; quos dum primos Dominus in sancta Ecclesia posuit tota in eis sequentis fabrica structura surrexit. Item, Semetipsum sacrificium pro nobis offeubi supra.rens

page.notes: The initial "N" is a decorated woodcut letter joined to "On" as "ON". The left marginal note "ubi supra." is set beside the paragraph with the initial. The word "offerens" is set on its own line at the right, continued from the previous line. Some small ink spots and stains are not transcribed. A rule divides the upper text from the italic heading.
